decisions.summary: The reader is a regex tokenizer over the SVG text, not an XML library, so the page carries the sheet's own bytes.
decisions.why: Mechanism only; serves FR-009 (the page is a second serialization of the same drawing) and narrows nothing asked.

decisions.summary: Ochiba is the single-artifact target; the other four maps follow as their own task.
decisions.why: Ordering, not scope: all five maps are still owed (FR-001, SC-001, User Story 2). Ochiba is the GM's named example.

decisions.summary: No performance bookends: no settlement-generator change; emit_svg gains attributes only.
decisions.why: Project procedure the request does not touch; FR-011 (no hamlet page changes) is still held by the hamlet interactive tests the plan names.

decisions.summary: building-review runs on Ochiba's page at acceptance, one map per agent.
decisions.why: Project review procedure; neither the request nor the spec asks for or against it, and it removes nothing the GM asked for.

decisions.summary: data-kind on the element or an enclosing <g>, the nearest wins; data-kind="-" is the not-highlighted ruling; a label is a child of its feature's group so it lights with the feature and the modal heading is the registry name. Side file and label-inference rejected.
decisions.why: Is FR-002 word for word (declared ON the element, nearest enclosing group wins, no side file) and the accepted design ('data-kind attributes'). The '-' ruling is the spec's edge case (background, title, scale bar ruled out with a recorded ruling, never untagged) and its Decisions row. The rejected side file is rejected for the GM's own stated constraint.

decisions.summary: flatten() re-opens tagged ancestors around each differently-tagged child fragment, document order kept, <svg> open/close and <defs> ruled '-', a re-opened ancestor's id dropped after the first copy.
decisions.why: Implements the spec's edge case 'the child's kind wins for the child's subtree; the rest of the group keeps the group's kind' and 'defs patterns are not ink and need no tag'; paint order unchanged serves FR-009.

decisions.summary: explanations / unregistered_classes / render_page / write_html take a registry defaulting to the hamlet CLASSES; no place card for a sheet; the lane default fires only for the hamlet key.
decisions.why: FR-001 (the same interactive page) and FR-011 (no hamlet page changes). No place card follows the spec's Assumption that a magistracy place card is not asked for and the placard is ruled not highlighted.

decisions.summary: One registry, interactive/compound_kinds/, in four family modules (grounds, office, household, particulars); the setting's particulars (threshold stones, Fox-Fire Lantern, salt wards, Fox border, parley room...) are kinds; a one-map fact about a generic kind goes in that map's .notes.md Features block keyed by kind; keys may coincide with hamlet keys because the registries are separate.
decisions.why: FR-003 (one registry, docstring form, shared by every magistracy), the accepted design ('map particulars such as the threshold stones as per-map kinds'), and FR-010 word for word (the particular reaches the modal from the map's notes, never a second copy of the kind). Separate registries serve FR-011.

decisions.summary: Each kind's Label is carried from an existing finding (a grounding section -> accurate; a folded types.json item -> its class with its why carried into the note, a guessed size becoming the caveat; canon-made -> deviation; a record-sanctioned enlarged glyph -> convention; else guess saying the record is silent); a kind no section covers declares 'no dedicated entry - recorded as silent' and lists no questions; the closing report lists both sets.
decisions.why: FR-005 in full, measured against coverage.md as FR-005 requires; the silent-Entry form produces exactly the missing 'See references' the spec's scenario 4 and User Story 4 ask for. Checked in the tree: gatehouse carries types.json's 'accurate' with a silent Entry; barracks is 'accurate' from B060 with the item's size guess as caveat.

decisions.summary: The program items clerks and guest, a room on some sheets and a building on others, become one kind each - clerks' room and guest quarters - written true of both forms; on a sheet drawing a room, the room's label carries the kind.
decisions.why: FR-003a requires each item to name the Mode A kind it is; one kind per item keeps the classification stated once, and neither the request nor the spec asks for a room form and a building form to be separate kinds. Checked in the tree: office.py ClerksRoom (Label guess, carried from the types.json item; Entry names B050) and household.py GuestQuarters (Label accurate, carried) each state 'Covers:' both forms. Every drawn form stays highlightable, so nothing the GM asked to see is lost.

decisions.summary: Each hand sheet's precinct rect is split at the divider into inner- and outer-court rects, both keeping id=precinct, the inner running 1 px under the outer to avoid an anti-aliasing seam; PNG and audit identity measured, falling back to a seam-free split without overlap if the audit's coverage figure moves.
decisions.why: FR-004 (each court a region of its own ground) under FR-009/SC-003 (PNG and audit unchanged), exactly as the spec's edge case and Decisions row describe. Both branches of the fallback satisfy both requirements.

decisions.summary: 'Ubame's border court is tagged as its own court if it is drawn as ground of its own; if it is not, its label and furniture are.'
decisions.why: FR-004 requires 'any further court a sheet draws, such as Ubame's border court' to be highlightable 'as a region of its own ground'; the else-branch licenses lighting only its label and furniture, which is 'X except where Y'. Not physically impossible: D6 itself is the proof that a court's ground can be given its own rect without moving a pixel, and nothing in the GM's words implies the carve-out. It is also unneeded - measured in the tree, ubame-magistracy.svg line 295 is <g data-kind="border court"> holding its own garden-stipple ground rect (x=920 y=462 106x94) under the BORDER COURT label. Strike the else-branch and state the measured fact.

decisions.summary: BuildingSpec gains feature (the kind key); emit_svg writes data-kind on every building, spine zone, point feature, wall, divider, gate, notice board; title/subtitle/scale bar '-'; the precinct split at divider_ft; a building with no feature is refused at emit time.
decisions.why: FR-008 word for word; the split carries FR-004 to the placer sheets; the emit-time refusal only enforces FR-008's 'the kind of every element it draws' and reaches nothing beyond it.

decisions.summary: Each .gen.py writes its page after its render, with_raster following DIAGRAM_SKIP_RENDER; one pool test flattens all five sheets and asserts no unclassed ink, no unregistered kind, every registered kind drawn somewhere, and the GM's two Ochiba examples.
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-006, FR-007, SC-001, SC-002 and the vector-only edge case. The tests only fail when the requested behavior is absent - enforcement of the request.

decisions.summary: RequiredItem is EITHER labeled (label/class/why - the country-shrine tier, unchanged) OR kinded (kind only), a mix refused; the parser records each tagged element's kind by opening-tag offset; a kind item's labels are those tagged with its kind, present when any element carries it, band measured on the first such label's structure; classification() returns the kind's label and note for the band finding and programs.md.
decisions.why: FR-003a and SC-006 exactly, including the country-shrine tier keeping its own entries (out of scope per FR-003a). The mix refusal enforces 'no magistracy item keeps a class, a why or a label pattern'. Audit identity is FR-009's own measure.

decisions.summary: The Mode A red fixtures are re-derived as the tagged sheet plus their own defect by three-way merge, checked for no untagged ink and an unchanged audit output.
decisions.why: Keeps the existing audit tests showing the one defect each exists for once FR-003a moves the audit onto tags; it adds no behavior and narrows nothing. Note for the author, not a fidelity ruling: the plan states this in the past tense ('needed a few tags by hand'), but in the tree no tests/fixtures/*-red.svg is modified and none carries data-kind (grep, 2026-09-26) - T11 is still to do.
